content: Without devotion, ritual is a dry branch. With love, every common action becomes high worship.
author: Kabir
explanation: Mechanical routines and superficial church/temple rituals without genuine heart are lifeless. Infusing ordinary tasks—cooking, cleaning, working—with heartfelt love sanctifies all of life.
practicalInsight: Perform your most mundane chore today—washing dishes or replying to emails—as an intentional act of loving service.
reflectionPrompt: Am I going through the motions of life mechanically without bringing love into my hands?
